values.meaning: bonus critical strike damage multiplier applied to the bounce when it critically strikes

mechanics.claim: Double Up applies on-attack effects to the primary target and on-hit effects to both the primary and bounce targets.
mechanics.quote: applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the primary target and {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit

mechanics.claim: The bounce shot can critically strike, and always does so if the primary target is killed by the initial hit.
mechanics.quote: If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will {{tip|critically strike}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability deals basic damage but is also tagged as spell damage, so it can trigger spell-effect interactions.
mechanics.quote: ''Double Up'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} to both targets, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: If there is no valid secondary target, the shot does not bounce and instead becomes a dud that lands on the ground, dealing no further damage.
mechanics.quote: If there is no secondary target, the shot will not bounce and the dud will instead fall to the ground.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield on either the primary or secondary target can block that instance of the ability, but a spell shield on the primary target does not prevent the bounce from occurring.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} can be used by either target. If it is on the primary target, the spell shield will not prevent the shot from bouncing.
